stories.headline: Speeding stop on a Nevada highway turns up roughly 700 pounds of suspected meth and fentanyl
stories.summary: A Lincoln County sheriff's deputy stopped a pickup near Ash Springs on October 13 and found about 307 kg of suspected methamphetamine plus roughly 14 kg of suspected fentanyl.
